notes: No null fields. IDs: the NCBI-disease PubTator files store bare MeSH IDs (e.g. D013167); the MESH: prefix is added to match the name source, datasets/CTD/CTD_diseases.tsv.gz (CTD MEDIC vocabulary, 'Report created: Tue Sep 29 13:07:12 EDT 2026'), where every name above was looked up by DiseaseID. Worked example: in the training split the exact string 'AS' is gold-labelled 10x Spondylitis, Ankylosing (D013167) and 11x Angelman Syndrome (D017204), so the string alone is ambiguous. The tree's preprocessing (abbrev_expansion='append', context_window=10) turns the mention into the query 'AS ankylosing spondylitis [SEP] accounts for a minority of the overall genetic susceptibility to .' because the abstract defines 'ankylosing spondylitis (AS)' earlier; the disambiguation therefore comes largely from in-document abbreviation expansion, not from the sentence alone. All 10 test 'AS' mentions (5 per sense, PMIDs 9336417 and 9585605) are ranked correctly at top-1 by this tree. Scores are the tree's raw candidate scores (leaf matcher score x routing-path probability x exp(knn_beta * max cosine) with knn_beta=10), not probabilities; they are only comparable within one query. The recorded scores come from the single-query command above; a batched prediction over the whole test split gave the same top-5 order with scores differing in the 4th-5th significant digit (e.g. 19282.4669 vs 19282.4899), presumably from batched float32 encoding. The tree was trained at commit b7b51ef13bc3fc26a91ee0f443f6a0a9f2a6757c (dirty: TUI/docs/test files only); between that commit and the HEAD used here (3789974) the xmr4el/ package changed only in comment/doc lines. Test-split inference was run once over the in-vocabulary rows (923 of 945) to choose the example; it is not a recorded evaluation. same_concept counts are exact, case-sensitive mention-text counts over gold annotations: MJD 25 train + 1 test, Machado-Joseph disease 12 + 1, SCA3 6 + 4, spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 1 train; dev has none. D017827 also has 'Spinocerebellar ataxia type-3', 'spinocerebellar ataxia 3' and 'spinocerebellar ataxia 3/Machado-Joseph disease' (1 each, train), not listed. same_name: 'FAP' is gold-labelled D011125 52x (train, dev and test) and D028227 2x (both in train PMID 2912886); the D028227 context is that document's title. A stronger-balanced alternative is 'AS' (D013167 15x, D017204 16x), not used here to avoid repeating the worked example's surface form. BC5CDR was not used.
